verdict.rationale: Gladia ships an official CLI (`gladia transcribe audio.mp3`) that writes text, JSON, SRT or VTT to stdout. Its docs say it is 'pipe-friendly' with 'machine-readable output for scripts and CI', and a simple transcription API sits alongside it, so headless and CI automation is directly supported. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use, and documentation of non-interactive auth (e.g., an env-var API key) and exit-code behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Pipe-friendly: machine-readable output for scripts and CI
Flexible output: plain text, JSON, SRT, or VTT to stdout
One command: install, set your key, run `gladia transcribe audio.mp3`
